# Does your branch protection still match your own policy?

> Paste your repo's GitHub branch protection settings and declared policy to find every rule that has drifted weaker than intended. Free, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/branch-protection-drift-check/)

- [Why branch protection drifts silently](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/branch-protection-drift-check/why-branch-protection-drifts.html)
